title: Bank merger won't override landlord's right to evict: Supreme Court orders PNB's eviction from CP
description: The Supreme Court recently held that a government-sanctioned merger of banks under the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, does not sweep away a landlord’s statutory protection against unauthorised subletting or assignment under rent control laws.A Bench of Justices Sanjay Karol and N Kotiswar Singh clarified that rent control provisions do not differentiate between "voluntary" and "involuntary" transfers of possession.
